verdict.rationale: Google Cloud ships an official, first-party CLI (`gcloud`) with install docs and a command reference covering authentication, configuration, developer workflow and API interactions, and the probe confirms it is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output guidance for agents), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
This quickstart describes the recommended method to install and initialize the Google Cloud CLI.
gcloud - manage Google Cloud resources and developer workflow
